FN-5PKIMMM-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 201
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator April Weaver
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/22/2024
Senate Bill 201 as introduced could increase receipts to local sheriffs, by an undetermined
amount, dependent upon the amount of court-ordered restitution collected by the sheriff for
costs incurred for housing and care of persons convicted of organized retail theft.
